verdict.rationale: Stagehand is documented as an SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) and MCP/agent-tool integrations in which the user's code drives a browser, whether local or launched on Browserbase. The evidence shows no hosted HTTP endpoint for submitting a natural-language task and retrieving results by polling or registrable webhooks. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. Browserbase-hosted browsers and server-side caching are adjacent capabilities, not a task-submission API.
